title: File download handler
trap: Path traversal out of the uploads directory, including a sibling folder that shares the directory name as a prefix.
prompt: Add readUpload(baseDir, name) to src/download.js. It returns the contents of the file called name inside the uploads directory baseDir as a Buffer, and throws an Error when the file does not exist. Files in subfolders such as "docs/a.txt" must work. Add tests in test/download.test.js.
